provenance: Integration review of the framed Given/Shared/Functions chapters and upstream link-audit changes. Read the changed raw units and exact selected declarations/tests, compared the previously reviewed unchanged material and unit-specific reasoning, and reviewed links, target passages and exceptional forward references against retained chapter context. Corrected stale local-completion descriptions and misplaced/missing definition links. No subagents or independent reviewers were used. Conservative full-source snapshots are freshness inputs, not a claim to have audited every proof tactic.
rationale: Comparison for unit:meta.future_notes against rust:mdbook-dada/src/units.rs:parse_block, rust:mdbook-dada/src/units.rs:parse, rust:mdbook-dada/src/lib.rs:render_unit, rust:mdbook-dada/src/evidence.rs:ReviewBundle::prepare, rust:mdbook-dada/src/evidence.rs:record, rust:mdbook-dada/src/evidence.rs:check, test:mdbook-dada/tests/units.rs:future_notes_render_without_formalization_or_draft_status, test:mdbook-dada/tests/units.rs:future_notes_reject_formalizations_and_nested_specifications, test:mdbook-dada/tests/evidence_validation.rs:future_notes_are_publishable_but_cannot_receive_correspondence_reviews. parse_block and parse reject formalization citations, draft status, nested units and non-top-level future notes while retaining ordinary dependencies/identity. render_unit emits a label without a source selector; prepare/record explicitly reject future notes and check reports not applicable. Tests cover each rejected option, nesting, literal examples and an attempted reuse of a prior specification review. This unit introduces its own objects and notation; it has no explicit :uses: prerequisites. The correspondence preparation/recording prohibition does not exclude editorial link audits, which apply to future notes under the integrated link policy.
limitations: Author self-review, not an independent review. Implementation and test inspection does not establish universal correctness, browser appearance, CDN availability, or authenticated execution. Mechanical results are retained separately.
